scope: Physical single-scattering sky environment for native mesh raster reflections, RT-chain misses and local-radial hemispherical diffuse ambient; not complete atmosphere or Bevy replacement

hardware.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 H 365, 10 cores / 20 logical CPUs

reproduction.silent: ALSA_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/target/render-batch/silent-alsa.conf PULSE_SERVER=unix:$PWD/target/render-batch/no-pulse-server PIPEWIRE_REMOTE=thessa-test-no-audio; native has no audio subsystem
reproduction.preview_off: same command with renderer.ray_tracing=off and a separate output path
reproduction.config: version=1, preset=high, renderer.surface_quality=high, renderer.specular_reflections=true, renderer.ray_tracing=local|off, shadows.enabled=true; atmosphere settings use preset defaults

contract.field: Backend-neutral validated equirectangular direction grid in body axes; azimuth wraps, elevation clamps, bilinear sampling; padded RGB texels use 16 bytes each
contract.physical_inputs: Baked body radius/mu/surface pressure/mixture gas constant, flight-authority reference T=288.15 K, shared N2/O2 optics baseline, ephemeris-derived stellar directions and inverse-square irradiance; 93 lm/W presentation scale
contract.ambient: Cosine-weighted local-radial hemisphere quadrature normalized to PI for uniform radiance. A single ambient for all diffuse normals is the existing isotropic-diffuse approximation
contract.disabled: No integration or grid upload; explicit ambient/PI fallback. Previously bound grid released, retaining 32-byte metadata and a 16-byte placeholder
contract.updates: First evaluation and changed budgets immediate; otherwise camera displacement >250 m, source direction >0.002 rad or weighted RGB change >1%, subject to quality frame interval. Every source is compared independently
contract.multi_star: Resolved multi_star=false selects the brightest stellar irradiance; true uses all sources
contract.density: Resolved density_scale multiplies scattering beta only, not absorption or authoritative atmosphere; resolved airglow independently controls the shared model's weak emission term
contract.rt_correction: Miss uses environment radiance(direction) * accumulated throughput * AO. Previous throughput * preweighted_environment double-applied primary Fresnel. The white-metal test could not detect it; dielectric/roughness/AO oracle now does

cpu_cost_error.scenario: Camera 1 km above radius 3200 km, mu=5.02e13, 120 kPa N2/O2 reference, 1000 W/m2 white star at (0.6,0.8,0), 24 requested view steps; 21 samples after warm-up; row-parallel existing Rayon
cpu_cost_error.reference: 128 view / 64 solar steps at 128 upper-hemisphere directions including near-horizon; absolute RGB radiance error divided by direct stellar E/PI, not by sky radiance
cpu_cost_error.asserted_envelope: max error <0.25*direct E/PI for this fixed fixture only
cpu_cost_error.limitations: Not a global angular/altitude/time error bound. Coarse horizon and forward Mie lobes remain underresolved. Frequency cap is not a latency guarantee

preview_diagnostic.measurement_boundary: One run per mode; mixes terrain streaming and renderer work, NOT isolated RT cost or a frame-time win. Pre-stream repeatedly ticks selection before the 30 warm-up +120 measured frames
preview_diagnostic.capture_limit: Not a deterministic geometry oracle, no same-config noise measurement for these new captures, no blind subjective review; shader oracles are correctness evidence

disabled.config: Same high/local preview config, plus [atmosphere] enabled=false

moving_survey.scene: Default 5 km surface-survey camera, orbit advanced by 0.006 rad/frame; NO vehicle-preview mesh. Final orbit=0.894 rad; 30 warm-up +120 measured frames
moving_survey.scope: Validates position-triggered sky refresh under live streaming. No mesh environment upload/RT scene in this survey; not an RT benchmark or a same-workload comparison against the static vehicle preview. Last-evaluation latency is not an average

final_application_checks.telemetry_assertions: Disabled grid/storage/uploads=0 and no integration; moving evaluation count >1 and <=76, final orbit 0.894 rad. Both application exit codes 0; captures retained locally under target/render-batch, not used as subjective/parity evidence

oracles: Uniform field samples identically including seam and poles; ambient uniform normalization; texel-centre roundtrip; malformed grids rejected
Local-up hemisphere integration distinguishes +Y/-Y/+X; airless body has no field
Cadence reuses unchanged inputs; secondary source motion invalidates; density change and disable invalidate immediately; independent airglow setting respected at zero scattering
Unset renderer equals explicit disabled; uniform field versus isotropic fallback measured 0 changed bytes
Directional mirror samples the reflected side, not just any field colour
White-mirror directional RT miss equals raster bytes; dielectric F0/roughness/AO agrees within 1/255
Binding growth/shrink/disable/repeated disable preserves rendering and releases grid storage
Native GPU regression: initial grid published immediately, repeated static scene uploads once, replacement renderer receives current field, disabling releases mesh grid and restores explicit ambient
Direct light composition reads the current adopted sample, without waiting for sky-cache refresh

verification.result: All listed checks passed locally; final release rebuild and the disabled/moving application scenarios exited 0
verification.agent_qa: python3 tools/agent-qa/check_architecture.py: 12 guarded crates; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agent-qa/tests -v: 5 tests
verification.scope: Local checks only; not remote CI or visual parity. Native ignored set includes the CPU sky-grid diagnostic as well as hardware/server tests. Unrelated ignored wall-clock physics diagnostics were not run

known_gaps: Physical sky-background rendering, directional terrain/ocean environment consumers, ground radiance and sun disks
Aerial perspective, multiple scattering and external eclipse visibility in native presentation
Texture/UV/normal/AO sampling in RT hits; hit roughness still unused; rough-environment prefiltering and denoising
Terrain/ocean/cloud/landmark RT scene membership, RT shadow rays, HDR/tonemapping/auto-exposure
Cross-platform runtime validation and complete Bevy parity
